meta.name: web-quality-audit
meta.description: Comprehensive web quality audit covering performance, accessibility, SEO, and best practices. Use when asked to "audit my site", "review web quality", "run lighthouse audit", "check page quality", or "optimize my website".

copy.tagline: 审计网站性能、可访问性与SEO质量
copy.tagline_en: Audit website performance, accessibility, and SEO quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a comprehensive web quality audit with actionable recommendations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 会分析网站代码或项目，找出性能、可访问性、SEO 和最佳实践方面的问题，并按严重程度给出修复建议和代码示例。
howto.when: 当用户要求审计网站质量时触发，例如说“审计我的网站”、“检查页面质量”或“运行 Lighthouse 审计”。

say.text: 审计我的网站，找出性能问题。
say.note: Claude 会分析网站并列出性能问题及修复建议。

say.text: 检查这个页面的可访问性。
say.note: Claude 会检查可访问性问题，如对比度、键盘导航等。
Claude 会提供 SEO 改进建议，如标题、元描述等。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes website code or projects, identifies issues in performance, accessibility, SEO, and best practices, and provides severity-ranked fixes with code examples.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users ask to audit site quality, e.g., "audit my site", "check page quality", or "run Lighthouse audit".

say_en.text: Audit my website for performance issues.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and list performance issues with fixes.

say_en.text: Check the accessibility of this page.
say_en.note: Claude will check accessibility issues like contrast, keyboard navigation.
Claude will provide SEO improvement suggestions like titles, meta descriptions.
